summary.headline: Eclipses and Planetary Transitions
summary.text: Astrological material on besieged cities, eclipses, and planetary transitions through the zodiac, with manuscript cross-references. It includes a red-titled letter of Theophilos to Deukalion and discusses the effects of Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, and Mercury entering Aries and other signs.
